== Course of events ==

Having already built a wooden body from saplings and bark, jointed with pegs, and fashioned with a neck to hold the pumpkin head, Tip completes the figure by dressing it in clothes taken from Mombi's chest. Once clothed, Tip names the finished figure 'Jack Pumpkinhead.'

The act gives the wooden frame its finished form and its identity, turning Tip's construction of body and head into a named figure, Jack Pumpkinhead, ready to be part of what follows in Tip's life under Old Mombi's roof.
